scope: Six complete published laughter reader essays, including Judgment and Weeping; DE/FR/ES/JA/KO independently rewritten from current Chinese. No replacement of original EN/Simplified/Traditional or academic papers.
source: Current HTML directly through scripts/laughter_source.py, not a copied Chinese JSON corpus or shortened academic source.
source_reading: Lead actually read all six complete Chinese bodies and complete index/apparatus, plus both previous bounded frozen-definition reports. This is not a new full scholarly audit of all mother papers.
quality_gate: Frozen small batches, actual complete nonauthor readings including all source and terminology notes, lead source adjudication, saved whole-field readbacks, genuine final approval before rendering. Paragraph counts alone do not certify prose.
boundaries: A particular reciprocal encounter remains two respective15DDmoments; complete16DD across every matter remains an ideal limit. Shared laughter/tears and not writing another experience do not establish recognition by themselves.
Judgment, emotion, outward expression and using laughter/tears to act are distinct; real laughter need not be correct or ethically justified.
Each event is classified, not an entire person's permanent rank. No duty to laugh, cry, suffer or maintain pain.
Keep all evidence limits: abstracts, bibliographic/secondary material, memory, legends, additional readings and candidate interpretations remain such, not new empirical findings.
Full despair and weeping conditions, independent signs, falsification pressure and unanswered comparisons remain; do not erase the possibility of correction or substitute comfort for aid.
Retain original Chinese wordplay with an explanation, not a newly invented joke. The optional joke collection is honestly labeled Chinese.
Two minor stale route/count phrases may be expressed without suggesting a new rank or fixing the number of candidate readings; original three-language prose remains unchanged.
primary_preservation: Before expansion: complete primary main areas, raw EN/Chinese bodies, whole seven HTML files and all seven offline Hant scripts fingerprinted. Only independently reversible language links/head blocks may be added.
deployment: One local commit after editorial/technical/browser acceptance, then only fairy-tales; never push.
acceptance: Real full independent readings, source-adjudicated local corrections and whole saved-field readbacks; strict evidence seal, saved page equality, original source preservation, discovery, search and sitemap checks completed. Desktop/mobile menu and source-panel interactions verified in local browser; no push.
